gate: per (lead x asset) cell on BTC-hedged residual: neutral_confirmed iff judge==paper_candidate (same-sign+practical+2x/3x cost+p<0.0125); residual_positive iff hedged exp>0 & same-sign; else beta_explained. raw (beta=0) anchor-x-checked against the cross-asset lane.
lane_description: Market-neutral falsification: beta-hedge each ETH/SOL breadth-lead trade against BTC over its holding window; re-judge the residual. Tests whether the leads predict the beta-residual or just ride crypto beta. beta=0 reproduces the cross-asset raw result (anchor).
